page.title: Connectors
page.description: Every service Elysium reads as you, the accounts it reads them through, and whether each one works.
page.empty: No connectors yet. Add one to start reading a service.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Syncs that record something or fail show up here.

actions.deleteBody: Elysium stops reading through it. What it already recorded stays on the timeline.
actions.deleteBodyWithAccount: A {{kind}} connector goes with its account, so the account is removed too, along with anything else that uses it, such as coding sessions' GitHub token.

jira.name: Jira
jira.description: Issues on a Jira Cloud site, bounded to the projects and boards you pick.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.description: Pages and comments in the spaces you pick, read through a Jira connector's Atlassian account.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Issues and pull requests, read through a personal access token.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.description: Your Outlook inbox, read through a browser you sign in to.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Your Gmail inbox, read through a browser you sign in to.

teams.name: Teams
teams.description: Your Teams chats and channels, read through a browser you sign in to.

fireflies.name: Fireflies
fireflies.description: Your recorded meetings, cut into segments on each project's timeline.

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Your Slack workspaces, read through a browser you sign in to. Direct messages, mentions, and thread replies land in your inbox.

youtrack.name: YouTrack
youtrack.description: Issues and comments on a YouTrack Cloud site, read with your own permanent token.

accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Adding a connector adds its account.
accounts.deleteBody: Every connector it feeds stops. The key stays valid with its provider until you revoke it there.

fields.name: Name
fields.everything: Everything it reaches, including what is added later
fields.truncated: The provider has more than one listing holds; only the first are shown.
fields.noOptions: Nothing to pick from yet. Fill in the account first.
fields.noStorageLocations: Add a storage location under Settings, Storage first.

wizard.title: Add connector
wizard.chooseAccount: Which account does it read through?
wizard.browserSignIn: This is read through a browser you sign in to. Sign in to one under Settings, Browser sign-ins, then pick it here.

noAccount.atlassian: No Atlassian account yet. One comes with a Jira connector: add the site as Jira first, then pick its account here.
noAccount.github: No GitHub account yet. One comes with a GitHub connector: add it first, then pick its account here.
noAccount.fireflies: No Fireflies key yet. Add a Fireflies connector with a new key first, then pick it here.
noAccount.youtrack: No YouTrack token yet. Add a YouTrack connector with a new token first, then pick it here.

wizard.requiredFailed: A required check failed. Fix it, or save anyway and come back to it.

checks.title: Connector checks
checks.never: These checks have not run yet.

labels.allowlist_reachable: Reach the chosen projects and boards

reasons.fine_grained_scopes: GitHub does not report a fine-grained token's permissions.
reasons.no_repositories: The token reaches no repository to sample.
reasons.no_projects_allowed: No project is allowed, so there is nothing to search.
reasons.sample_unread: The sample could not be read.
reasons.signed_out: The service is asking you to sign in again.
reasons.mailbox_not_open: No tab in the browser shows the mailbox.
reasons.teams_not_open: Teams is not open in the browser yet. Elysium opened it; run the checks again once it has loaded.
reasons.teams_store_not_found: Teams is open, but Elysium did not find the chats it stores.
reasons.no_messages: The inbox shows no messages to sample.
reasons.no_meetings: No meeting in the last two weeks to sample.
reasons.meeting_unavailable: The newest meeting is not available yet.
reasons.spaces_unresolved: The chosen spaces were not resolved.
reasons.no_spaces_chosen: No space is chosen, so there is nothing to search.
reasons.slack_not_open: No tab in the browser shows Slack. Elysium opened one; run the checks again in a moment.
reasons.no_workspace_reached: The browser is signed in to none of the chosen workspaces.
reasons.no_conversations: No conversation it reads has a message to sample.
reasons.projects_unreachable: The token reaches none of the chosen projects.
reasons.no_issues: The chosen projects have no issue to sample.
